title: Microsoft AI Foundry & Bringing Your Own Models and Agents
audience: Developers, AI Practitioners, and Solutions Architects
summary: Deploying, hosting, and connecting custom models and agent backbones in Microsoft AI Foundry, and linking private endpoints to local IDEs.
objectives: Provision and deploy frontier and open-weight models in Microsoft AI Foundry
Connect private Foundry endpoints to local tools and IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, Cline)
Configure agent system prompts, tool interfaces, and security boundaries
Manage token quotas, spend ceilings, and context window limits

title: Advanced Multi-Agent Orchestration & Topologies
audience: AI Engineers, Systems Architects, and Technical Leads
summary: Architecting robust multi-agent systems with hierarchical delegation, immutable memory boundaries, consensus ensembles, and framework mappings.
objectives: Implement supervisor, router, and peer-to-peer multi-agent topologies
Enforce strict memory boundaries and immutable context handoffs between agents
Construct debate, critique, and verification ensembles for high-stakes tasks
Map agentic architectural patterns to LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel
Implement circuit breakers and bounded execution limits to prevent runaway loops
